activity.notes: Tito became President of Yugoslavia on 14 January 1953. This Activity remains under the Federal People's Republic of Yugoslavia until 7 April 1963, when the new constitution formally renamed the state the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia.

sources.title: Broz, Josip - Tito — Hrvatska enciklopedija
sources.citation_text: The Croatian Encyclopedia records Tito's election as President of the Republic in January 1953 and his continued rule until 1980.

sources.title: Constituent Acts of Yugoslavia — Archives of Yugoslavia
sources.citation_text: The Archives identifies the SFRY Constitution of 7 April 1963 and states that it changed the name of the state.
